description.narrative: Xurya is a solar development and asset management company based in Indonesia that sources, develops, operates, and maintains distributed solar projects. SEACEF II is investing $5m in the first tranche of funding (50%), and BII is co-investing $2.5m (50%) alongside the Fund.

mailing-address.narrative: BII plc, 123 Victoria Street, London, SW1E 6DE, United Kingdom

sector.narrative: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers

description.narrative: This is our first equity investment in Indonesia since BIIís re-entry to South East Asia under our 2022-2026 strategy. Its also our first co-investment alongside SEACEF II, managed by Clime Capital, which is also investing $10 million in this $55 million round. Other investors include Norfund, Swedfund, and AC Ventures.Xurya is a pioneer platform in Indonesia supporting commercial and industrial customers (C&I) to decarbonise. Xuryaís target solar power capacity of 600 megawatts by the end of 2028 is expected to help avoid approximately 700,000 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2e) per year. Through scaling-up C&I solar deployment, this investment will also support Indonesiaís ambitions for renewable energy to contribute at least 34 per cent of all power generation by 2030 and reach net zero in the power sector by 2050.
